title: State--Generator Geometry of Open Quantum Systems: Compatibility and Covariant Transport
summary: We develop a geometry for transporting stationary-state response across the control space of an open quantum system. A physical model is represented by the ordered pair of its stationary state and dynamical generator. Embedding these pairs in a common ambient space induces a metric, a response one-form, and a closed two-form on the control manifold. The ambient space admits a canonical complex structure that exchanges state and generator directions, but the Liouvillian null-state condition restricts physical models to a submanifold that need not preserve this structure.
